 Seeking an Electrical/Test Engineer with hands-on experience in control panel design, component selection, electrical schematics, NI LabVIEW development, and NI hardware platforms. This role offers the opportunity to design test systems, develop LabVIEW-based software, support verification and validation, and contribute to advanced aerospace test equipment.
  
 The successful candidate will design electrical control systems, specify data acquisition and control hardware, develop LabVIEW based software for test equipment, participate in budget and schedule estimation, lead equipment verification & validation efforts, and provide support for delivered test equipment within the Mechanical Power Conversion (MPC) division of Collins Aerospace. The test equipment is utilized for production, R&D, and qualification testing of cutting-edge military and commercial aerospace products including fuel pumps, air turbine starters and blowers, engine and air frame gearboxes, and lube and scavenge pumps
  
 The ideal candidate is eager to grow their expertise in aerospace test systems, controls, data acquisition, and LabVIEW while working on production, R&D, and qualification testing.
  
 What You Will Do 
  
 Develop, maintain, and update LabVIEW software in Windows, FPGA, and Real-Time OS environments for manual and automated test equipment and stands. 
 Specify and implement appropriate NI cRIO, cDAQ, and PXI hardware solutions 
 Utilize LabVIEW coding best practices including well documented, scalable, maintainable, and modular code based on standardized architecture and common design patterns such as QMH and State Machines 
 Design electrical control panels, power distribution systems, and electrical circuits for aerospace test equipment. 
 Develop and maintain electrical schematics (in AutoCAD Electrical), wiring diagrams, and engineering documentation.   
 Work on cross-functional teams which include Product Development Engineers, Sustaining Engineers, Program Managers, Quality Engineers, Manufacturing Engineers, and Operations Managers. 
 Estimate confidential test equipment proposals including specifications of proprietary hardware or software, equipment design documentation, schedules, and budgets. 
 Lead test equipment activities including design, build, assembly, checkout, verification/validation, and commissioning 
 Develop performance, maintenance, and calibration requirements for test stands and equipment. 
 Participate/lead peer reviews of specifications, designs, and concepts for test equipment, components, and systems. 
  
 What You Will Learn 

 Gain experience managing projects from conception to completion, including development, planning, execution, and delivery of large-scale test stands and equipment. 
 In-depth knowledge of the complete product family, including fuel pumps, oil pumps, air turbine starters, blowers, and gearboxes, with a strong understanding of their functions, and the validation processes. 
 Advanced LabVIEW programming skills 
  
 Qualifications You Must Have 

 Requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) unless prohibited by local laws/regulations and minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience  
 Experience designing control panels, selecting components, documenting schematics 
 Demonstratable experience with NI LabVIEW development and NI hardware platforms 
  
 Qualifications We Prefer 
 Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (BSEE). 
 CLA or CLD certification 
 Experience programming NI LabVIEW for Real-Time (RT) and FPGA platforms.   
 Intermediate-level experience with AutoCAD Electrical for electrical schematics, drawings and technical documentation. 
 Experience with industrial automation, controls, and test system integration.  
 Experience working within the aerospace industry 
 Hands-on experience with hydraulics, pneumatics, air compressors, motors, Variable frequency Drives (VFDs), torque sensors, temperature controllers, and flowmeters 
 Experience programming and implementing safety controller and safety related control systems 
  
 What We Offer   
  
 Some of our competitive benefits package includes:     
 Medical, dental, and vision insurance     
 Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees     
 Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option     
 Tuition reimbursement program    
 Student Loan Repayment Program     
 Life insurance and disability coverage     
 Optional coverages you can buy: pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection    
 Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits    
 Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning     
 Adoption Assistance              
 Autism Benefit     
 Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions     
 Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program    
 Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits     
 Bright Horizons, child and elder care services    
 Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program     
 And more!     
  
 Learn More & Apply Now!   
  
 We make modern flight possible for millions of travelers and our military every second.  Our major product lines are on-board virtually every aircraft flying. Be it keeping passengers safe with our emergency power generation systems or creating a positive in-flight experience through reliable cabin pressure controls and quieter engines, Power & Controls focuses on delivering a best-in-class experience to our customers. We hire the top people in the industry. Their ideas drive our performance, and their integrity keeps our customers happy. Join us as we take flight!   
  
 *Please ensure the role type (defined below) is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role.   
  
 Onsite:  Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.  
  
 At Collins, the paths we pave together lead to limitless possibilities. And the bonds we form – with our customers and with each other -- propel us all higher, again and again.     
  
 Apply now and be part of the team that’s redefining aerospace, every day.    
 
 
 As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote. 
 
The salary range for this role is 68,900 USD - 131,100 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills. 
 
 
Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. 
 
Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance. 
 
This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply. 
 
RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window. 
 
 RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.
